history.summary: An integrated development directly on top of Buangkok MRT (10m) with mall, hawker centre and community club — best-in-class connectivity and amenity for a D19 1BR. At $910k / $1920 psf it sits below the $2067 project median, and the 367-txn series gives a reliable ~2.9% resale CAGR.
history.rating_rationale: Integrated/transit-oriented developments command durable resale and rental premiums; this one is literally on the MRT with an attached mall. $1920 psf vs $2067 median is a ~7% discount, and 367 txns make the data trustworthy. 1BR is niche but the integrated-mall location is the deepest possible tenant pool for the format. Low quantum ($910k) keeps it liquid. Downside: 1BR resale appeals mainly to investors, and the ~2.9% resale rate is OCR-typical not stellar.
red_flags: 1BR is investor/single-tenant niche — narrower owner-occupier resale pool
~2.9% resale CAGR is modest (OCR-typical), not a growth standout
High PSF for D19 (paying integrated-development premium up front)
catalysts: Direct integrated connection to Buangkok MRT + Sengkang Grand Mall + hawker centre
Below-median entry PSF (7% under project median)
Punggol Digital District tenant demand in the broader NE corridor
